name: sekoia-cti
description: Sekoia MCP Server for threat intelligence. Ask CTI questions in natural language (indicators, actors, sectors, CVEs, campaigns, reports), check whether a threat already fired or appears in your own Sekoia telemetry, derive hunt packs from FLINT reports, and produce evidence-disciplined Sekoia Intelligence reports: exposure assessments and sector RFIs, threat horizon assessments, intelligence delta briefs, with an evidence manifest, HTML and PDF.
